description: This PHP class 'OAuthTokenMarkDeletedService' handles the process of marking OAuth tokens as deleted based on expiration times or revocation status. It interacts with the database to update token statuses and includes logging and configuration retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: OAuthTokenMarkDeletedService
classes.description: A service class responsible for marking OAuth tokens as deleted based on expiration or revocation.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the process to update OAuth tokens, setting them as deleted if expired or revoked.

methods.name: getDBManager
methods.description: Retrieves the database manager instance; throws an exception on failure.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with specified severity, section, and message details.

methods.name: getOAuthTokenDeleteThreshold
methods.description: Retrieves the threshold used to determine token deletion timing, defaults to '-7 days' if configuration is invalid or absent.
